entities.name: Dosso Dossi

entities.summary: Giovanni di Niccolò de Luteri, better known as Dosso Dossi was an Italian Renaissance painter who belonged to the School of Ferrara, painting in a style mainly influenced by Venetian painting, in particular Giorgione and early Titian.
